title: The two DB tripwire test files assumed the gitignored data/ folder exists, so on a fresh checkout dbTripwireSetup.test.ts crashed in beforeAll (CI skipped its 11 rail tests) and dbTripwireSrc.test.ts failed in afterAll; an empty data/ also made the setup file silently skip its final unchanged check
severity_rationale: S3: no production path is involved and a machine with data/ passed, but these rail tests did not run on CI at all.

evidence.ref: GitHub Actions run 42627936916 (PR #2, commit 776858c), step npm run test:unit
evidence.note: 2 files failed: ENOENT scandir data/ in beforeAll, and expected false to be true in afterAll; 11 tests skipped.
beforeAll lists the real data/ folder unconditionally.
afterAll required the real data/ folder to exist.

evidence.ref: clean-clone replay of the CI steps with no data/ folder, Node 22.16.0
evidence.note: With the folder check fixed, three open cases returned "Cannot open database because the directory does not exist": better-sqlite3 lib/database.js:64 refuses before the native constructor the rail wraps. With the final fix, 937 of 937 unit tests pass and no data/ folder is created.

sibling_sites_checked: Searched test/, scripts/verify-prod-untouched.ts and scripts/capture-baselines.ts for paths joined to the repo data folder. childProbe.cjs uses a fake root, childRails.test.ts passes a literal path to a pure check, and forkRails.fork.test.ts does not list or stat the real folder. selfcheck.cjs and the two scripts are not run by CI. The full unit and integration suites pass in a clean clone with no data/ folder and none of them creates one.
red_proof: Clean clone with no data/: forcing isProtectedDbPath to return false, and separately forcing it true for a non-data path, each fails the three real-root open cases; restored, 11 of 11 pass. With a folder present the real tripwire is asserted unchanged.
recommendation: Done: ea193b8 records the folder state instead of requiring it, and asserts the rail decision directly when the folder is missing.
